verdict.rationale: Fedora Workstation's own site says GNOME Boxes "takes the guesswork out of using virtual machines": the user just selects the OS and the app does the rest. That directly matches quick VM creation without manual configuration. The VirtualBox glitch report concerns Fedora running as a guest, not Fedora's VM tooling, so it is not relevant here. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of Boxes' capabilities (automatic OS download, unattended install, resource defaults), and independent or hands-on corroboration that VM creation works as smoothly as claimed.
